description: Configure and manage Claude Code provider settings, models, and built-in Chat.
configuration.apiKey.description: API key used to authenticate with the configured provider.
configuration.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic-compatible provider endpoint.
configuration.model.description: Default model id used for new conversations.
configuration.models.description: List of available model ids for the configured provider.
configuration.providers.description: Configured provider list, each with its own endpoint, key, and models.
configuration.activeProvider.description: Id of the currently active provider.
configuration.temperature.description: Sampling temperature applied to chat completions.
configuration.maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate per response.
configuration.systemPrompt.description: System prompt prepended to every conversation.
configuration.chat.enabled.description: Enable the built-in Chat panel backed by the Claude CLI.
configuration.chat.cliPath.description: Absolute path to the Claude CLI executable used by the built-in Chat.
configuration.chat.cliArgs.description: Additional command-line arguments passed to the Claude CLI on launch.
configuration.chat.cliEnv.description: Extra environment variables injected into the Claude CLI process.
configuration.chat.permissionMode.descri: Default permission mode for the Claude CLI used by the built-in Chat.
configuration.chat.cwd.description: Working directory for the Claude CLI process; defaults to the first workspace folder.
configuration.chat.transport.description: Transport used to communicate with the Claude CLI (stream-json over stdio).
Include MCP servers declared in .vscode/mcp.json when launching the Claude CLI.
configuration.chat.mcpServers.descriptio: Inline MCP server definitions merged into the Claude CLI launch configuration.
configuration.chat.skills.description: Skill names enabled via --allowedTools; use "all" to enable every Skill.
configuration.chat.tokenBudget.enabled.d: Enable automatic context compaction when token usage approaches the model context window.
configuration.chat.tokenBudget.threshold: Fraction (0-1) of the context window at which automatic compaction is triggered.
configuration.chat.tokenBudget.targetRat: Target fraction (0-1) of the context window to compact down to.
configuration.chat.tokenBudget.minInterv: Minimum interval in milliseconds between automatic compaction attempts.
configuration.chat.dispatcher.appendSyst: Optional override of the main (dispatcher) CLI appended system prompt. The main CLI handles everything directly and may call the ask_expert tool on demand. Leave empty to use the built-in default.
configuration.chat.expert.appendSystemPr: Optional override of the appended system prompt used by the on-demand expert sub-turn. Leave empty to use the built-in default.
configuration.chat.expert.enabled.descri: Enable the on-demand expert (the ask_expert MCP tool). When true and an expert model is set, the main CLI may delegate a self-contained question to the expert; its trace is shown in the Chat panel but never enters the main conversation context.
configuration.chat.expert.model.descript: Model id used by the on-demand expert sub-turn. Empty string means the expert is unavailable and the main model answers directly.
configuration.chat.expert.userTriggerMod: How user-triggered expert calls (the @llsExpert or /expert prefix) are handled. 'direct' shows the expert answer directly to the user; 'tool_result' writes the expert answer back to the main CLI as a tool_result so the main model continues the turn.
Show the expert answer directly to the user.
Write the expert answer back to the main CLI as a tool_result.
configuration.chat.userTriggerMode.enumD: Show the expert answer directly to the user.
Write the expert answer back to the main CLI as a tool_result.
configuration.chat.expert.maxSteps.descr: Maximum number of tool-using steps the expert sub-turn loop is allowed per ask_expert call (default 6).
Per-step timeout in milliseconds for the expert sub-turn loop (default 60000).
configuration.chat.expert.totalTimeoutMs: Total timeout in milliseconds for one ask_expert sub-turn (default 300000).
configuration.chat.expert.maxCallsPerTur: Maximum number of ask_expert calls allowed within a single dispatcher turn (default 1).
Reserved; no runtime effect (kept for backward compatibility).
configuration.chat.expertMode.project.en: Project-level switch for the on-demand expert (the ask_expert MCP tool). When true, the main Claude CLI sees ask_expert and may delegate complex investigations to an expert sub-turn whose entire trace is visible in the Chat panel but never enters the main conversation context. Overrides the global value. Leave unset to inherit chat.expertMode.global.enabled.
configuration.chat.expertMode.project.mo: Project-level model id used by the expert sub-turn. Empty string inherits chat.expertMode.global.model; if that is also empty, the expert is unavailable. Stored under workspace .vscode/settings.json.
configuration.chat.expertMode.project.ap: Optional project-level override of the expert appended system prompt. Leave empty to inherit the global value or built-in default.
configuration.chat.expertMode.project.ro: Reserved; no runtime effect (kept for backward compatibility).
configuration.chat.expertMode.global.ena: Global default switch for the on-demand expert, applied to all workspaces unless a workspace overrides it via chat.expertMode.project.enabled. Stored in user settings and synchronized via Settings Sync.
configuration.chat.expertMode.global.mod: Global default model id for the expert sub-turn. Empty string means the expert is unavailable. Project-level chat.expertMode.project.model overrides this value.
configuration.chat.expertMode.global.app: Optional global override of the expert appended system prompt. Leave empty to use the built-in default.
configuration.chat.expertMode.global.rou: Reserved; no runtime effect (kept for backward compatibility).
configuration.chat.compactionMode.projec: Project-level switch for the dedicated compaction model. When enabled and a model is selected, Claude /compact requests are routed to this model instead of the normal chat model.
Project-level model id used only for Claude /compact requests. Empty string inherits chat.compactionMode.global.model; if none is configured, compaction uses the normal chat model.
configuration.chat.compactionMode.global: Global default switch for the dedicated compaction model, applied unless the workspace overrides it.
Global default model id used only for Claude /compact requests. Project-level chat.compactionMode.project.model overrides this value.
